goal: 将 FantasyWord 唯一动态资源主轴从 Addressables/Resources 重构为 YooAsset，并完成 UIKit 与 Mod 包验收

evidence: Packages/com.tuyoogame.yooasset/package.json: version 3.0.4
Packages/packages-lock.json: com.tuyoogame.yooasset source=embedded
Unity final state: isPlaying=false, isCompiling=false, scriptCompilationFailed=false

acceptance_criteria.description: ResourceSystem 与 ModLoader 不再依赖 Addressables 运行时

acceptance_criteria.description: YooAsset Collector、EditorSimulate 与句柄释放链可验证
evidence: EditorSimulateBuildInvoker produced Bundles/StandaloneWindows64/DefaultPackage/Simulate with 3 manifest files
PlayMode loaded localization TextAsset and verified the shared ResourceHandle became invalid after Dispose
UIKitSmokeValidator passed before its prefabs moved out of Tests/Resources, with stack depths 1 -> 2 -> 1 -> 0 and no failures
Both smoke prefabs now exist under Assets/Editor/GameCore/Tests/Fixtures/UIKit, but the final-path PlayMode smoke is pending because ClickMoveTest remains dirty

acceptance_criteria.description: Resources 只保留明确允许的启动配置，遗留资源已分类收口
evidence: scripts/Invoke-ResourceOwnerStaticGate.ps1: UnexpectedResourcesAssetCount=0
Assets/Resources contains only DOTweenSettings.asset plus metadata
Formal UI, fonts and localization assets were moved with their existing GUIDs

acceptance_criteria.description: 项目规范、决策、门禁与依赖清单同步完成
evidence: .spec/decisions/0069-yooasset-dynamic-resource-mainline.md
node .spec/tools/spec-lint.mjs: passed
scripts/Invoke-ResourceOwnerStaticGate.ps1: CollectorContractPresent=true, Passed=true

acceptance_criteria.description: 独立 Mod 真包可由 ResourceSystem 初始化、加载、释放和移除
evidence: ModSmokePackage Collector was created and then removed after the build attempt
YooAsset ScriptableBuildPipeline stopped at TaskPrepare_SBP with ErrorCode101: Found unsaved scene
scene-list-opened confirmed Assets/Scenes/ClickMoveTest.unity remains dirty; no save or discard was performed

notes: DefaultPackage compile, collect, simulate, runtime load, localization and formal UIKit validation passed.

The final-path UIKit smoke and Mod bundle end-to-end check require the unrelated dirty ClickMoveTest scene to be saved or otherwise cleared by the user before PlayMode/build verification can continue.
